## Body

Ruling C35 (Jordan, 2026-11-22, RULINGS a75c9819): every new feature or F-item needs JORDAN's own approval before any seat builds it, opens a PR or rolls it out. The prime's GOs don't count (about 40 F-items, F228-F279, were approved by the prime alone; Jordan ruled that too much).
What pm-001 may still do:
- Diagnose read-only, and send findings to the prime as a short proposal (what, why, cost). The prime puts them to Jordan one at a time.
- Finish work Jordan already approved. A bug in shipped work found by review (a C34 follow-up of an approved item) is part of that item, not a new one.
- Close review seats with no approved work.
- Never revive non-pij-fleet seats (Jordan does that himself).
First case: F279 (a lapsed Copilot seat's stale 'working' state blocks its own restart control) was paused at packet stage. Falcon has the packet (msgs/f279.md) and holds coder/f279; it waits for Jordan.
